entries.6decb556ebe42b0c: A company engaged in a contract-closing support business that supports corporate customers such as electricity and gas providers and staffing companies, from customer acquisition to contract closing, on a performance-based fee basis.
entries.775a04ff1ed104aa: This is the single segment of the group consisting of the company and 14 consolidated subsidiaries. To address companies' management challenge of contract conclusion activities, it supports the process from attracting prospective users through to contract conclusion on an end-to-end basis, and operates the business on a performance-based fee model in which compensation arises upon contract conclusion. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥29,100 million.
